title: FOIL terms that have an $$x$$
text: The terms that have an $$x$$ come from adding the outer and inner terms.

title: Cancelling $$x$$ terms
text: The outer and inner terms must add to zero, this happens when you have a difference of squares $$x^2-b^2$$

title: Difference of squares
text: A difference of squares arises from a product of the form $$\left(x+b\right) \left(x-b\right)$$.
